basic_details.scholarship_name: Hamad Bin Khalifa University Graduate Scholarship & Research Funding (Qatar Foundation)
basic_details.offering_entity: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU) & Qatar Foundation for Education, Science and Community Development
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (Education City, Doha, State of Qatar)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Science and Engineering (Computer Science, AI, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Sustainable Energy, Biological and Biomedical Sciences), College of Health and Life Sciences, College of Humanities and Social Sciences, College of Law, and College of Islamic Studies.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 180 merit and research funding awards allocated annually across colleges
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally on competitive academic merit; Pakistani students represent a prominent graduate cohort in Education City (~15 to 25 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years for Master's; 3 to 4 years for PhD
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: QAR 5,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 380,000 / month); QAR 7,500 / month for PhD (~PKR 570,000 / month) plus subsidized housing

nationality_requirements: Open to international students worldwide and Qatar residents (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No upper age limit; evaluation is based on academic merit, research competence, and potential.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's degree with minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00 for Master's; recognized 18-year Master's degree with minimum CGPA 3.00 / 4.00 for PhD from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Relevant undergraduate/postgraduate degree in computing, engineering, life sciences, or related disciplines.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated applicants or final-year students completing degree before enrollment.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Professional experience or prior research publications are strongly beneficial for PhD applicants.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Valid IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (minimum 79) mandatory for all English-taught colleges.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: GRE / GMAT scores are strongly recommended for College of Science and Engineering applicants.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to male and female scholars; separate graduate student accommodation facilities in Education City.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Scholarship awarded concurrently with admission based on academic excellence and research profile.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with another concurrent corporate or governmental award.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver for the complete official duration of the graduate degree program.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~QAR 72,000 to 120,000 / year value; ~PKR 5,500,000 to 9,100,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Non-refundable application processing fee of QAR 400 (approx. USD 110) paid by the candidate upon submission.

accommodation.details: Single-occupancy furnished graduate housing within Qatar Foundation Education City residences, with utilities, high-speed internet, and campus security.

monthly_stipend.details: Generous monthly tax-free living stipend: QAR 5,000 / month for Master's (~PKR 380,000 / month); QAR 7,500 / month for PhD (~PKR 570,000 / month).

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy flight ticket between Pakistan and Hamad International Airport (DOH) in Doha.

visa_fee.details: Qatari student residence permit and visa sponsored and processed directly by Qatar Foundation / HBKU without charge.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive medical healthcare access through Hamad Medical Corporation (HMC) health card and university clinics.

food_allowance.details: Education City dining halls and grocery markets available; meals funded independently from generous monthly living stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Access to Qatar National Library and Education City digital scholarly repositories; software and research equipment provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Exceptional research grants and conference travel sponsorships up to QAR 10,000 to 15,000 per year through HBKU and Qatar National Research Fund (QNRF).
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to QAR 15,000 research & conference grants

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free Education City modern tram transit system and shuttle buses connecting residential housing, research institutes, and metro stations.
travel_transit_allowance.amount: 100% free Education City tram and shuttles

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single elite research institution (Hamad Bin Khalifa University, Education City).
participating_institutions: Hamad Bin Khalifa University (Education City, Doha, Qatar)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Times Higher Education World University Rankings #150-200 for Computer Science and Engineering, top research hub in MENA with Qatar Environment and Energy Research Institute (QEERI) and Qatar Computing Research Institute (QCRI).
available_majors: Master of Science in Data Science and Engineering
Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence
PhD in Computer Science and Engineering
Master of Science / PhD in Sustainable Energy
Master of Science / PhD in Genomics and Precision Medicine
Master of Science / PhD in Biological and Biomedical Sciences
Master of Arts in Applied Islamic Ethics
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree with minimum CGPA 3.00, official transcripts, IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 79+, two academic recommendation letters, research proposal/statement of purpose, and CV.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: College of Science and Engineering (Cybersecurity, AI, Data Science) is highly selective with strong technical screening; PhD admissions prioritize matching with funded faculty research projects.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Connecting with HBKU faculty researchers or QCRI scientists whose research aligns with your prior publications significantly boosts selection likelihood.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Hamad Bin Khalifa University Online Admissions Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on HBKU admissions portal, select college and graduate program, provide referee email contacts, upload digital transcripts, test scores, research proposal, and pay application fee.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check college entry requirements and verify IELTS/TOEFL scores.
Step 2: Create profile on HBKU admissions portal and submit application with QAR 400 fee.
Step 3: Upload transcripts, degree certificates, CV, research proposal, and referee contacts.
Step 4: Referees submit electronic recommendations directly through the portal.
Step 5: College graduate committee screens dossiers and conducts shortlisted technical interviews via Microsoft Teams/Zoom.
Step 6: Successful candidates receive admission offer accompanied by scholarship funding letter.
Step 7: Accept offer, complete visa processing through Qatar Foundation, and arrange flight to Doha.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Fellowship Track: Academic admission application automatically considers candidates for full scholarship and research funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted electronically via automated referee email links generated by the portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (750 to 1,000 words) detailing academic background, research interests, career aims, and reasons for choosing HBKU.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Detailed research proposal (3 to 5 pages) required for PhD candidates and thesis-track Master's outlining research methodology and significance.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Comprehensive academic CV detailing publications, conference presentations, technical skills, and academic achievements.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous technical video interview conducted by departmental faculty committee evaluating subject mastery and research potential.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ or TOEFL iBT 79+ mandatory; GRE General test recommended for Science and Engineering.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA Pakistan attestations required; Qatari Embassy attestation needed prior to formal registration.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified English translation of non-English records.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Graduation Certificates
required_documents_checklist.specification: Bachelor's / Master's degrees with minimum CGPA 3.0 / 4.0 from an HEC-recognized university.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC and MoFA Pakistan.
Submitted directly to HBKU institutional code.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential assessments from former professors or research supervisors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Submitted electronically via institutional academic email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 3 to 5-page research proposal for PhD or detailed motivation letter for Master's.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Outlining specific research domain and alignment with HBKU research institutes.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic CV detailing publications, awards, technical skills, and research background.
Clear color copy of passport personal bio-data page valid for at least 1 year.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single primary intake per academic year for international scholarship holders, starting in August (Fall).

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Research proposal quality, publications, and conference outputs)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: HBKU College Admissions Committee, Faculty Research Supervisors, and Qatar Foundation Scholarship Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic merit-based review with heavy weighting on research capability and alignment with Qatar National Research Strategy.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3.0% to 5.0% for highly qualified STEM applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA >= 3.60 / 4.00, typically with published papers or substantial research thesis
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates with top-decile GPA, demonstrated publication record in reputable journals/conferences, and clear research direction.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Alumni of top Pakistani institutions (NUST, LUMS, FAST, GIKI, Quaid-i-Azam, COMSATS, UET) and international graduate institutions.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Iran, Egypt, Jordan, Turkey, Nigeria, Lebanon, Qatar.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only submit applications through official portal at hbku.edu.qa.
Qatar Foundation does not authorize agents or brokers to guarantee admission.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: QAR 400 fee is paid exclusively via the official online application portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: HBKU does not work with commercial student recruitment agencies.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS or TOEFL test fees: ~PKR 55,000 to 65,000.
Attestation costs across HEC, MoFA, and Qatar Embassy: ~PKR 25,000 to 35,000.
Initial pocket money before first stipend deposit in Doha: ~QAR 1,000 (~PKR 76,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: HBKU is only for Qatari nationals. Reality: The student body is intensely international, with over 60 nationalities represented.
Myth: Arabic fluency is required for all programs. Reality: STEM, Law, and Public Policy curricula are taught 100% in English.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently quote obsolete stipend rates; current rates are QAR 5,000 (Master's) and QAR 7,500 (PhD).

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative graduate GPA of at least 3.00 / 4.00 each semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time campus residency and regular attendance in coursework and lab research activities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Biannual academic progress evaluation and annual thesis milestone review.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars are engaged as Graduate Research Assistants (GRA) or Teaching Assistants (TA); off-campus commercial employment is restricted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return bond; graduates can pursue post-doctoral fellowships or employment in Qatar or globally.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to dedicate 10-15 hours per week to departmental research/teaching duties during the award period.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship terminated if student fails to maintain academic progress or commits honor code violations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Permitted only under exceptional circumstances with approval from both colleges and funding sponsors.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum 1 additional semester extension may be granted for PhD defense with committee endorsement.
